repos.name: Miku
repos.description: Miku is a feature-rich, native Android application for tracking anime and manga on AniList. Built with Wails 3, it combines a high-performance Go backend with a Vue 3 frontend to deliver a smooth experience.

repos.name: book-tracker
repos.description: A simple, client-side web application for tracking your reading list. Built with plain HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript — no frameworks, no build step, and no backend.

repos.name: Akashic
repos.description: Akashic is a free and open-source alternative to Windows Notepad, built with Go and Wails.

repos.name: bitchat
repos.description: bluetooth mesh chat, IRC vibes

repos.name: gitscope
repos.description: GitScope is a lightweight and intuitive Git GUI client built with Go and wails designed to make version control simple, easy to implement.

repos.name: mimo-skills
repos.description: A collection of my mimo code skills that i use for day to day use.

repos.name: gkport
repos.description: GKPort is a fast, terminal-based CLI and TUI tool designed for Windows developers. It helps you discover and kill common development server ports (like 3000, 8080) or any listening TCP port. It is built with Bubble Tea for a smooth interactive interface.

repos.name: Chest
repos.description: Chest is a deterministic file organization and automation CLI tool built in Go. Inspired by the Minecraft chest, CHEST sorts files into compartments with reversible operations, fast concurrent search, and extensible plugin support.

repos.name: Gocut
repos.description: Gocut is a fast, lightweight, fully offline video editor for the desktop. Built with a Go backend (Wails) and Vue 3 frontend, it offers a multi-track timeline and other features without uploading footage to the cloud.

repos.name: mai-companion
repos.description: The mai-companion repository is a calm, intelligent GitHub companion built with Cloudflare Workers and TypeScript that automatically reviews issues, pull requests, and discussions using the Google Gemini API.

repos.name: Predator
repos.description: Predator is a lightweight, cross platform desktop application for downloading videos and extracting audio from YouTube. It is built using Go and wails GUI framework, with go-ytdlp wrapper used as the download engine. The application focuses on simplicity, and a clean user experience .

repos.name: gosqlite-ffi
repos.description: Go-sqlite-ffi is an  experimental CGO-free Go binding prototype for SQLite's C API using purego.

repos.name: Mai
repos.description: Mai is a fully offline, voice-driven AI assistant built in Go. It processes everything locally using optimized ONNX models, ensuring complete privacy and fast, customizable performance without any cloud dependency.

repos.name: light
repos.description: Light is a zero-config, cross-platform file-sharing tool for local networks. Built with Go and Vue 3, it uses UDP beacons for instant device discovery and QR codes for secure pairing. Transfer files instantly with real-time progress, checksum verification, and a privacy-first design. No internet required.

repos.name: Mana
repos.description: Mana : Go framework for real-time apps: WebSocket, rooms, signaling, WebRTC & E2EE. Perfect for chat, collaboration tools, and MVPs.

repos.name: LearnFlow
repos.description: LearnFlow is a high-concurrency Go/Chi LMS bridging education and freelancing. It features AI personalization, GitHub-based code assessments, and a built-in marketplace to turn learners into hired professionals.

repos.name: go-cognitive-voice
repos.description: A pure Go library for speaker detection and identification. Zero CGo, zero ML frameworks—just math. Enroll speakers with WAV/MP3 files and get real-time identification with MFCC, GMM, and neural embeddings

repos.name: panda-editor
repos.description: A modern Terminal User Interface (TUI) text editor written entirely in Go.

repos.name: Gotunnel
repos.description: GoTunnel is an enterprise-grade, self-hostable tunneling platform — a secure, scalable open-source alternative to ngrok, built for teams that need more than a simple tunnel.

repos.name: fyne-x
repos.description: Community extensions to the cross platform GUI in Go based on Material Design

repos.name: retrieval-go
repos.description: A production-oriented Go web retrieval library for LLM tools: DuckDuckGo HTML search + readable content extraction to give agents “internet access”, with robust defaults (headers/UA rotation, decompression, timeouts, body limits)

repos.name: Remainwith
repos.description: Remainwith is a real-time communication platform built with Go and WebRTC, designed for scalable peer-to-peer and SFU-based audio/video calling. It leverages Pion WebRTC for media handling and supports features like codec negotiation, port forwarding, and SFU improvements. Ideal for developers building low-latency communication apps.

repos.name: goml
repos.description: GOML (Go Markup Language) is a simple, human-readable data format designed to solve common pain points in configuration files like JSON, YAML, and TOML. It offers three flexible syntax styles Flat, Dot Notation, and Block—allowing developers to choose the best approach for their use case, to complex nested configurations.

repos.name: Writedown
repos.description: WriteDown is a simple, fast CLI note-taking app in Go. Create, edit, list, and delete notes from your terminal with an intuitive menu. Cross-platform, lightweight, and easy to use—perfect for quick notes without a GUI.

repos.name: AnimeUpscale
repos.description: A Go CLI tool for upscaling anime and illustration images using Real-ESRGAN and RealSR backends. Features native execution, video support, and multiple model presets.

repos.name: portless
repos.description: A lightweight local service router that replaces `localhost:3000` with `api.localhost` - zero port conflicts, process supervision, Docker auto-discovery, and LAN collaboration out of the box

repos.name: lucid
repos.description: Dream Journal 🌙 is a personal, secure web application designed for capturing and tracking dreams. Built with Go (version 1.21+) and PostgreSQL (version 15+), it allows users to record detailed dream descriptions, track associated moods (like Calm, Happy, or Haunted), and control privacy levels for each entry.

repos.name: Brain
repos.description: Brain is a Chrome extension that automatically captures AI conversations from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok, saving them directly to your Obsidian vault via the Local REST API. With full privacy, auto-capture, and graph-friendly linked notes, it turns fleeting AI chats into a permanent, searchable knowledge base 100% local, open source.

repos.name: goclean
repos.description: Multi-language package cache cleaner with an interactive TUI. Find unused dependencies and reclaim disk space.

repos.name: qc
repos.description: A simple Go package providing basic arithmetic operations and utility functions like prime and factorial calculation.

repos.name: Gllama
repos.description: Gllama is a high-performance LLM inference engine and server built with Go, powered by llama.cpp via native CGO bindings. It offers an OpenAI-compatible API, advanced sampling options, semantic embeddings, and real-time telemetry — making it a fast, resource-safe backend for running local AI models.

repos.name: Persona
repos.description: Persona is a privacy-focused browser extension for Brave and other Chromium-based browsers (Chrome, Edge). It lets you save and instantly switch between multiple user accounts and workspaces (e.g., Dev, Personal) with a single click. All data is stored locally no telemetry, no cloud sync.
